description: This file defines a Grain class named ClientAddressableTestConsumerGrain which implements IClientAddressableTestConsumer. It contains methods for setting up a producer and polling it asynchronously, and references external interfaces and grains related to Orleans actor framework.

classes.name: ClientAddressableTestConsumerGrain
classes.description: A Grain class implementing IClientAddressableTestConsumer, used for testing client addressable interactions with a producer in Orleans framework.

methods.name: PollProducer
methods.description: Asynchronously polls the producer for a value.

methods.name: Setup
